pipelines.name: Check Management API Types

steps.name: Check for diff
steps.run:
if ! git diff --exit-code packages/mcp-server-supabase/src/management-api/types.ts packages/mcp-server-supabase/src/management-api-v2/types.ts; then
  echo "::error::Management API types are out of date. See the job summary for the update PR."
  branch=chore/regenerate-management-api-types # must match sync-management-api-types.yml
  {
    echo '## Management API types are out of date'
    echo
    if ! pr_url=$(gh api --method GET "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/pulls" -f state=open -f "head=$GITHUB_REPOSITORY_OWNER:$branch" --jq '.[0].html_url // empty'); then
      echo "Could not look up the generated types update PR."
    elif [ -n "$pr_url" ]; then
      echo "Generated types update PR [#${pr_url##*/}]($pr_url) is open. Check that it includes these changes, then merge it and update your branch."
    else
      echo "No generated types update PR is currently open. [Run the sync workflow]($GITHUB_SERVER_URL/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/actions/workflows/sync-management-api-types.yml) to create one, then merge it and update your branch."
    fi
  } >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
  exit 1
fi

pipelines.name: Release

steps.name: Validate force publish ref
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
if [ "$WORKFLOW_REF_TYPE" != "branch" ] || [ "$WORKFLOW_REF_NAME" != "main" ]; then
  echo "Select main when running force_publish."
  exit 1
fi
if [ -z "$RELEASE_TAG" ]; then
  echo "Enter an existing GitHub release tag when running force_publish."
  exit 1
fi
if gh api --silent "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/releases/tags/$RELEASE_TAG"; then
  echo "Force publishing from release tag $RELEASE_TAG."
  exit 0
fi
echo "Selected tag $RELEASE_TAG is not associated with a GitHub Release."
exit 1

steps.name: Publish @supabase/mcp-utils to npm
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
VERSION=$(node -p "require('./package.json').version")
NPM_VIEW_STDERR=$(mktemp)
EXISTING=$(npm view "@supabase/mcp-utils@$VERSION" version 2>"$NPM_VIEW_STDERR") || STATUS=$?
if [ -n "$EXISTING" ]; then
  echo "Version $VERSION already published, skipping."
  rm -f "$NPM_VIEW_STDERR"
  exit 0
elif [ "${STATUS:-0}" -ne 0 ] && ! grep -qiE 'E404|not found' "$NPM_VIEW_STDERR"; then
  cat "$NPM_VIEW_STDERR"
  rm -f "$NPM_VIEW_STDERR"
  exit 1
fi
rm -f "$NPM_VIEW_STDERR"
pnpm publish --no-git-checks --ignore-scripts --access public --provenance

steps.name: Check MCP registry version
Wait for npm version to be available
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
VERSION=$(node -p "require('./package.json').version")
for _ in $(seq 1 30); do
  if curl -fsS -o /dev/null --max-time 10 "https://registry.npmjs.org/@supabase%2Fmcp-server-supabase/$VERSION"; then
    exit 0
  fi
  sleep 10
done
echo "npm version $VERSION not available after 5 minutes" >&2
exit 1
